header.running_head: The Du'aas Rasulullaah ﷺ Made for the Four Khulafaa

blocks.text: Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) narrates that when he once stayed in the room of (his aunt) Hadhrat Maymoona (RA), he kept the water ready for Rasulullaah ﷺ to perform wudhu. "Who put this water here?" Rasulullaah ﷺ asked. When Hadhrat Maymoona (RA) informed Rasulullaah ﷺ that it was Hadhrat Abdullaah (RA), Rasulullaah ﷺ made du'aa for him saying, "O Allaah! Grant him deep understanding of Deen and teach him the interpretation of the Qur'aan."[^1]

Another narration quotes the du'aa as, "O Allaah! Teach him the Qur'aan and grant him deep understanding of the Deen."[^2] Yet another narration quotes the words as, "O Allaah! Teach him wisdom (the Sunnah) and the interpretation of the Qur'aan."[^3]
A narration from Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) states that Rasulullaah ﷺ's words were, "O Allaah! Bless him and spread the Deen through him."[^4]
The Du'aas Rasulullaah ﷺ Made for Hadhrat Ja'far (RA) and his Children and for Hadhrat Zaid bin Haaritha (RA) and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Rawaaha (RA)
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Ja'far (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ once made du'aa saying, "O Allaah! You be Ja'far (RA)'s successor in (caring for) his children."[^5]

Another narration states that the du'aa Rasulullaah ﷺ made was, "O Allaah! You be Ja'far (RA)'s successor in (caring for) his family and bless (his son) Abdullaah in trade." Rasulullaah ﷺ repeated this du'aa thrice.[^6]

Hadhrat Sha'bi states that after Hadhrat Ja'far (RA) was martyred at Balqaa during the Battle of Mu'ta, Rasulullaah ﷺ made du'aa saying, "O Allaah! You be Ja'far (RA)'s successor in (caring for) his family better than You would be a successor to any of Your righteous servants."[^7]

Hadhrat Abu Maysara narrates that when Rasulullaah ﷺ received the news of the martyrdom of Hadhrat Zaid bin Haaritha (RA), Hadhrat Ja'far (RA) and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Rawaaha (RA), he got up to speak about them. Starting with Hadhrat Zaid (RA), Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "O Allaah! Forgive Zaid. O Allaah! Forgive Zaid. O Allaah! Forgive Ja'far and Abdullaah bin Rawaaha."[^8]
Ibn Najjaar, as quoted in Muntakhab Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.5 Pg.231).
Ibn Maajah, Ibn Sa'd and Tabraani.
Abu Nu'aym in his Hilya, as quoted in Muntakhab Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.5 Pg.228).
Ahmad and Ibn Asaakir. Tabraani and Ibn Asaakir have also reported the narration from Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA).
Tayaalisi, Ibn Sa'd, Ahmad and others.
Ibn Abi Shaybah, as quoted in Muntakhab Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.5 Pg.155). Ibn Sa'd (Vol.4 Pg.39) has reported a similar narration.
